image.build_notes: Built on the isolated bench daemon (unix:///data/docker-bench/docker.sock) with the legacy builder (DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0, --network host). VLLM_REPOSITORY was overridden to a local git-daemon (git://127.0.0.1:9418/vllm-hist.git) serving the full, content-verified upstream vLLM history, because the bench host's only github egress (proxy) EOFs on the large history pack. Provenance is asserted by content in-image (HEAD==base_commit, tree match, rev-list>1, not shallow, oracle absent, clean tree) and verified post-build via task_ci.py image-check. codeload + files.pythonhosted.org fetched directly.

gates.verification: pass for recorded controls and alternatives

contract.boundary: CUDA operands and optional out -> production deterministic batched Triton multiplication and compatible output copy -> numeric and bitwise correctness, original out object and conversion contents, original invalid input behavior, bounded launches and unchanged A100 latency ratios
contract.decision: Preserve baseline out copy semantics, including dtype/device conversion and broadcast-compatible destinations. Reject only originally invalid shapes. No new same-dtype/device out restriction.

review.coverage: Six dtype/shape numerical and bitwise cases, 24 out-copy cases (two alternate dtypes, CPU destination and leading broadcast dimension per case), seven invalid-input cases, launch batches 1/7/29, three unchanged timing shapes with 5 warmups/20 iterations/5 median rounds.
review.substitutions_and_limitations: A100 CUDA/Triton production execution. Model serving is outside this tensor-kernel boundary. Performance measured on the three public shapes, not all possible workloads.
